clips.caption:
Ten years in federal prison. The warden had processed thousands of inmates — and told Kevin Trudeau he was the only one who looked happy to be there.

You don't choose what happens to you. You choose what it means. Call ten years a sentence, and you serve one. Call it a sabbatical, and you fill it with yoga, languages, books, people worth meeting. Same walls, a completely different decade — because the walls never decided that. He did.
